name: Rock RMS
shortDescription: An open-source church-management system supported by Spark Development Network, with self-hosted and partner cloud-hosting routes.
suitableContexts: Churches with technical capacity or an implementation partner
Multi-site organisations needing a configurable platform

editorial.assessment: Rock RMS is not a low-effort free option: its open-source licence shifts significant responsibilities to the church or implementation partner. It can suit technically capable or larger organisations, but should be evaluated with a realistic hosting, support, security and migration budget.
bestFor: Technically resourced churches and multi-site organisations
Teams that need substantial configurability and can support an implementation
strengths: Open-source platform and flexible hosting paths
Pricing approach distinguishes supplier support from hosting cost
limitations: The reviewed supplier material does not describe a standard trial
UK data protection, support, payments and Gift Aid require project-specific assessment

procurementVerdict.problem: Technically resourced churches and multi-site organisations
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Ask how the chosen hosting route can be evaluated safely

longForm.verdict: Rock RMS is a platform choice, not simply a software subscription. Its appeal is configurability and control; its trade-off is that hosting, implementation, security and ongoing technical stewardship become core parts of the decision.

decisionLens.heading: Open source changes who owns the operational risk.
decisionLens.text: No licence fee does not mean no cost. A church needs named ownership for infrastructure, upgrades, security, backups, incident response, integrations and user support before beginning a migration.

sections.heading: Cost beyond the code
sections.question: Who will run and support the live platform?
paragraphs: Rock RMS describes a suggested Spark donation based on average weekend attendance, alongside self-hosting and partner cloud-hosting routes.

Build a multi-year budget including hosting, implementation, data migration, security work, support and staff time. Confirm the terms and data location of any chosen cloud provider before loading church data.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score. It is grounded in Rock RMS’s published licensing and pricing approach.
themes: Hosting and implementation capability are decisive.
A project plan is needed before product configuration begins.
userFeedback.caveat: This profile does not establish suitability for a particular church or any supplier’s UK compliance position.

faq.question: Is Rock RMS free?
faq.answer: Rock RMS is open source. The supplier also describes a suggested Spark donation, while infrastructure, implementation and support can carry separate costs.

faq.question: How is Rock RMS priced?
faq.answer: The supplier states a suggested $4.45 annual donation per average weekend attendee. Self-hosting and cloud-hosting costs vary separately.

faq.question: Does Rock RMS have a free trial?
faq.answer: Ask the chosen cloud partner about its trial arrangement. The right evaluation path depends on whether the church self-hosts or uses a partner.
